newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, one buyer lifts fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, one buyer lifts fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday morning, with one buyer lifting the fuel oil barge market, while gas oil was steady, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil traded at $86 and twice at $86.50 fob Rotterdam. A trading house bought all three barges, although appeared to be losing interest by mid-morning.
Traders said there were no other buyers in evidence and the market could therefore retreat sharply.
Heating oil barges were virtually unchanged with underlying IPE April gas oil futures fairly steady and physical demand still thin. -- Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004
